meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Payment System Indicators (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: Monthly figures are provisional when first printed and may be revised in later Bulletins; the RBI re-organised the table in November 2019, and the two layouts are kept apart.
meta.coverage: How many cheque clearing houses India had each year, 2005 to 2026, MICR and non-MICR, by the bank that managed them
meta.note: RBI Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India, Table 27, via DBIE report 936 (data providers DP4 total, DP3 non-MICR by manager, DP2 MICR by manager, printed in brackets). Footnote marks in the source (*, $, #) are dropped; where a bracket reads 15+2*, the two are added. The managers' split stops after 2020; the table's 'Total' row in DP3 prints 0 and is not used. Years as the RBI labels them, end-March.
